I answered Pree in a thread on her #central-team message: the store was **Pine Crossing**.

The source is Pree's own message in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026. She wrote that the morning receiver at Pine Crossing saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis said he would check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem using the store's login.

I only used sources Pree can see: that channel and the public files. Neither gives any more location detail for Pine Crossing, such as a city or address. I told her the sheet entry would just be "Pine Crossing" for now.
